title: Read Smarter: Abstracts, Introductions and Main Ideas
objective: Students learn skimming, scanning, close reading, and identifying research purpose.
context: Practice abstract: We asked when birds visit a garden. We watched for ten minutes in the morning and ten in the afternoon. We saw eight birds in the morning and three in the afternoon.

items.prompt: What question did the team ask?
items.answer: When do birds visit a garden?

items.prompt: Find the time spent watching and both counts.
items.answer: Ten minutes in each period; eight in the morning and three in the afternoon.
items.hint: Scan for numbers and time words.

items.prompt: Write the main finding in one clear sentence.
items.answer: During this observation, more birds visited in the morning.
